narrative: The tiring-house, a quarter before two. The gown for the opening is on. No new name is pinned to it. The plot on the peg is the comedy. The street door is still shut. He stands where Egeon begins. The yard is filling. Nothing on the gown says a part. The book-keeper's plot is the only title in view, and it names the play, not the man.
